userStories.title: Sample Dispatch Model & Dispatch Management API
userStories.description: Extend SampleRequest model with courier details, AWB tracking, documents (COA/SDS), notes, and implement admin sample management endpoints with RBAC and audit logging
acceptanceCriteria: SampleRequest model includes courier, awbNumber, trackingUrl, dispatchedAt, deliveredAt, documents, notes, and assignedTo fields with idempotent table migration
Courier tracking URL generator automatically creates live tracking links for DHL, FedEx, UPS, Aramex, and India Post
GET /api/v1/samples supports filtering by status, search query, country, and pagination
PATCH /api/v1/samples/:id allows updating pipeline status, courier, AWB, and notes with audit log recording
POST /api/v1/samples/:id/dispatch transitions sample to dispatched, records AWB and tracking URL, and logs audit record
RBAC strictly enforces that only admin and sales roles can manage sample dispatches

userStories.title: Sample Dispatch Desk UI with Pipeline & Detail Drawer
userStories.description: Build complete Sample Dispatch Desk page using DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminDrawer with 4 operational tabs
acceptanceCriteria: Samples page renders with DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminStatusBadge components
Table displays Reference No, Buyer & Organization, Destination Country, Products & Qty, Testing Parameters, Courier & AWB with live link, Status, and Received Date
FilterBar provides status pills for all sample pipeline stages (New, In Review, Preparing, Dispatched, In Transit, Delivered, Feedback Received)
Detail drawer features 4 focused tabs: Sample Specs & Shipping Address, Dispatch & AWB Tracker, COA/SDS Attachments, and Audit Notes
Dispatch action validates courier and AWB before confirming dispatch with live tracking URL preview

userStories.title: Technical Document Attachments & Sample Test Coverage
userStories.description: Implement COA/SDS technical document management for evaluation samples and verify with automated test suite
acceptanceCriteria: Admin API client in client/src/admin/api.js provides fetchAdminSamples, fetchAdminSampleById, updateAdminSample, dispatchAdminSample, and attachSampleDocument
Automated integration tests in server/tests/sample.test.js cover sample creation, status updates, AWB dispatch, document attachments, and RBAC security
All client and server test suites pass with 100% success
Zero visual regression on public site verified via verify:no-change
